title: organizational_authority.assigned event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 20.5/19e.20. Produced by epd2_organization_service.events.build_organizational_authority_assigned_event. Minimum payload only: the authority's own id, its status (proposed or active - PROPOSED when dual control gates activation, ACTIVE otherwise), policy_version, decision_reference, effective_time (the authority's own valid_from), and recorded_at - deliberately omits role_code, scope, appointing_authority_reference, and assigned_subject_reference entirely (canon 19e.20's own identity-minimization rule: no unrelated identity data broadcast on the wire event; these fields remain in the full authority_state_payload used only for Audit Core's after_hash).
